notes: Library protocol: alkaline-fragmented RNA, 3' linker ligation, size excision of ligated products (footprint-style protocol) for both the mRNA-seq and total RNA-seq arms: assay_class other. Rifampicin time course 0.5-10 min: abx_transcription, acute, transcription_arrested; t0 untreated samples are controls. Carbon source of EZ Rich not stated.

assay_class.q: ligation to 3’ linker oligos (sequences provided in the publication) using T4 RNA ligase 2 truncated KQ (New England Biolabs, M0373) at 16°C overnight. The ligated products from different samples were pooled and purified by size excision.
